description: Canonical lifecycle for every ANAS OS project.

stages.objective: Prove that the problem and buyer demand are real enough to justify product definition.
Turn validated demand into a bounded product and safe technical plan.
Prove correctness, security and acceptance criteria.
Run the product reliably and support users.
Observe business, product, system and cost outcomes.
Convert evidence and failures into decisions and system improvements.

transitionRules: Never infer evidence that is not recorded.
High-risk actions require approval regardless of lifecycle stage.
A failed gate blocks the transition until remediation is recorded.
Exceptions expire and must be reviewed.
